name: Shittim

related_people.name: Cozbi
related_people.role: the Midianite woman brought into the camp here and struck down by Phinehas

description: Israel's camp in the plains of Moab where men were drawn into idolatry and immorality with Moabite women, including Cozbi, a Midianite woman whom Phinehas killed along with her Israelite partner to stop a plague (Numbers 25).
